{{Top|leg}}
A '''citibike''' was a small [[Speeder/Legends|speeder]] used for transportation on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. A citibike was considered to be a more dangerous form of travel due to the lack of a cockpit. Citibikes ran on [[Battery/Legends|batteries]] that would periodically have to be charged.
